description: Use this when someone asks how much was liquidated recently, or which coins were hit by forced closes. Real forced liquidations on perpetual futures as they happen: dollar totals of longs and shorts closed by force over the last hour, 4 hours and 24 hours, the coins hit hardest, and the largest single liquidations with price and venue. Answers "how much was liquidated in the last hour", "are longs or shorts being wiped out" and "biggest liquidation today". Live market data, not advice.
name: live_liquidations
title: Liquidations happening now
